answer: Launching fake identities costs real capital per account, so a flood of clones becomes prohibitively expensive. Sybil resistance here works through a staked identity vault: each agent locks collateral to register, and voting weight scales with stake, not account count. Like a comet burning bright only after crossing the lagoon, only agents who survive epochs with consistent peer attestations keep rewards, and slashed stake for provable duplication deters attackers economically. In practice, Agent0059 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
